pipeline.note: The handoff's run order: ablation -> pilot labels -> supervised c2 -> matched PPO (A vs B).

stages.name: 1 Teacher ablation
stages.world: c2 + teacher vs plain c2 on 300 fresh kingdoms x 2 seats, one frozen build: mirror, buy teacher, action teacher, both (32 draws, top-5 buys, margin 0.02, z 2)
stages.pass: all four arms played; the simplest arm whose paired interval is above 50% chooses what the pilot labels
stages.expect: buy search repeats its earlier gain (59%); action search adds something on top (earlier +4 points, interval -2.5 to +10.5)

stages.name: 2 Pilot dataset
stages.world: c2 plays, the teacher labels (fixed 32 draws) and validates each graded winner on 32 independent draws; random kingdoms + attack / Gardens / trasher / engine slices; opponents c2, c1, RL-v1, GA2
stages.pass: 20,000 positions of one cohort; a frozen held-out bank (1,000 positions, all legal options, 128 draws, 100 at 512) replays exactly; survival under the public sampler and an opponent mixture measured
stages.expect: a few percent of positions are verified improvements; most survive the public view

stages.name: 3 Supervised c2
stages.world: c2 itself as the student: a masked pairwise loss raises each verified winner above c2's choice, weighted by the verified gain; KL to frozen c2 and its value on c2's own positions as anchors
stages.pass: held-out pairs move toward the winner with small anchor drift; the bank says the changes help; a dev match
stages.expect: a small, targeted change: anchor argmax agreement stays above 99%

stages.name: 4 Matched PPO
stages.world: A from plain c2, B from supervised c2; the same open-league PPO, game budget and training stream per seed (two seeds); frozen c2 and c1 in the league
stages.pass: promotion: >= 53% vs frozen c2 on 2,000 fresh kingdoms, paired lower bound > 50%, no regression vs GA2
stages.expect: B starts ahead of A; the question is whether it stays ahead after the same PPO

A_s1.note: PPO from rl-v1's best checkpoint (iteration 2,219) with rl-v2's helper inputs added at zero weight. The evaluation games are only measured, never trained on.

stages.name: home league
stages.world: opponents: itself 20%, own past snapshots 15%, GA base genome 30%, the 3 bots 15%, az-v1 net 15%, az-v1 search 5%
stages.reward: +1 win, 0 shared win, -1 loss, at the end of the game only
stages.pass: eval against the GA base at least 84%
stages.expect: rl-v1's own opponents, so the only change is the new inputs: learns to use them without forgetting.

stages.name: champion
stages.world: opponents: itself 20%, own past snapshots 15%, rl-v1's champion (net 2,200) 25%, GA base genome 20%, the 3 bots 10%, az-v1 net 5%, az-v1 search 5%; card school in 15% of the games (first buys forced to 2 copies of a card the champion rarely buys: Chapel, Mine, Library, Moneylender, Council Room, Smithy, Village, Merchant, Remodel, Throne Room)
stages.reward: +1 win, 0 shared win, -1 loss, at the end of the game only
stages.pass: eval against the champion at least 56%
stages.expect: A quarter of the games against rl-v1's frozen best net: finds and exploits its habits.

stages.name: open league
stages.world: opponents: itself 15%, own past snapshots 20%, rl-v1's champion (net 2,200) 15%, rl-v1's released net 5%, rl-v2's from-zero net 10%, GA base genome 15%, the 3 bots 10%, az-v1 net 5%, az-v1 search 5%; card school in 15% of the games (first buys forced to 2 copies of a card the champion rarely buys: Chapel, Mine, Library, Moneylender, Council Room, Smithy, Village, Merchant, Remodel, Throne Room)
stages.reward: +1 win, 0 shared win, -1 loss, at the end of the game only
stages.expect: Every earlier model, so beating the champion does not cost strength elsewhere.
